title: </sub>  Adjudicate Ronda-only findings before counting clean reviews
text:
</sub>  Adjudicate Ronda-only findings before counting clean reviews

When the external reviewer is clean but either Ronda configuration produced a finding, these lines say the pull request counts as soon as the external clean result is confirmed, even though the preceding cohort rule requires every compared finding to receive a terminal outcome. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier denominator fix is that the latest change now includes defects found by either Ronda configuration in the denominator, so treating an externally clean review as fully adjudicated can promote the cohort with unresolved Ronda-only findings and later misclassify the denominator as zero. Restrict this shortcut to cases where all compared reviewers are clean; otherwise require adjudication of the Ronda findings.
